bounded_paraphrase: The published Python 3.10 signal documentation says default SIGINT can become KeyboardInterrupt and a raised signal-handler exception may occur after an arbitrary bytecode instruction. This validates the reported single-exception trace, but does not certify installed provenance or make arbitrary Python sequences atomic.
